# 2 Clement — Chapter 2 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 2
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. "Rejoice, O barren one who does not bear; break forth and shout, you who are not in labor; because the children of the desolate one are more than those of her who has a husband." — When he said "Rejoice, O barren one who does not bear," he spoke of us; for our church was barren before children were given to it.
2. "And shout, you who are not in labor" — this means: offer up our prayers to God sincerely, and not grow weary as those who are in labor.
3. "Because the children of the desolate one are more than those of her who has a husband" — this was said because our people seemed to be abandoned by God; but now, having believed, we have become more than those who seemed to have God.
4. And another scripture says: "I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners." — This means that those who are perishing must be saved.
5. For it is great and wonderful to establish not those who are standing but those who are falling.
6. So also Christ willed to save those who were perishing, and he saved many, coming and calling us who were already perishing.
